experiment: E18 the diagram-kind model in CATIA Magic: keywords held as metaobjects, read back by a tool (issue I-35)
setup: library/UML3DiagramKinds.sysml holds, per diagram kind, the keywords a view shows, the keywords a palette creates and the view definitions that render it, each as a metaobject ('ClassMetadata meta KerML::Type') in a 'KerML::Type[0..*]' attribute. customization/catia-magic annotates every palette with '@PaletteForDiagramKind { kind = UML3DiagramKinds::classDiagram meta KerML::Type; }'. Checks: load of the new library and of the annotated customization, the validation engine on both, and tools/cameo-scripts/probeDiagramKinds.groovy, which evaluates the three lists of every kind and prints the elements it gets back.

predictions.claim: UML3DiagramKinds loads with 0 builder errors: an attribute typed by the reflective metaclass KerML::Type and bound to a sequence of 'meta' casts is accepted (the standard library binds SemanticMetadata::baseType the same way, but single-valued)
predictions.observation: library/UML3DiagramKinds.sysml loads with 0 builder errors; 17 files now load (8 libraries, 6 examples, 3 customization)

predictions.claim: The validation engine reports no ERROR for UML3DiagramKinds
predictions.observation: The validation engine reports 0 failures on all 17 packages, UML3DiagramKinds included

predictions.claim: The annotated customization loads and is not flagged, and the palettes still verify (6/6 views, 45 templated buttons)
predictions.observation: The annotated customization loads, is not flagged, and the palettes verify: 6/6 views, 45 templated buttons, UML3 Create View dialog active

predictions.claim: A script can read the model: evaluating classDiagram::shows returns the 12 listed keywords and metaclasses, classDiagram::creates the 18 keywords, and classDiagram::views the 2 view definitions, each as an element whose name matches the file
predictions.observation: probeDiagramKinds evaluated every list: classDiagram reads back 12 shows, 18 creates and 2 views, with the names the file lists (keyword definitions, the metaclasses Package, EnumerationDefinition, PortDefinition, PortUsage, ConnectionUsage, and the view definitions); the label reads back as the string 'class diagram'. cameo_check now compares the counts and labels the tool evaluates with the model as parsed from the file, so the two cannot diverge

predictions.claim: A kind that binds no value (classTable::creates, sequenceDiagram::shows and creates) evaluates to an empty list rather than failing
predictions.observation: classTable::creates and sequenceDiagram::shows/creates, which bind no value, evaluate to empty lists

furtherObservations: Loading the customization a second time without cleaning the project made every palette fall back to the General View palette: CATIA Magic removes visualizations whose names collide (the vendor code logs a warning and drops them), so duplicate view definitions silently disable the customization. One more reason to run the harness on a clean project.

The diagram-kind model is consumable by a tool, which is what issue I-35 asked for: a generator could build the 45 palette buttons from classDiagram::creates and the other kinds instead of repeating the keywords.
conclusion: Keywords held as metaobjects in a KerML::Type[0..*] attribute load, validate and evaluate in CATIA Magic, so the diagram-kind model is a usable single source: tools/check_diagram_kinds.py compares it with the 12 view filters and the 6 palettes locally, and cameo_check compares the model with what the tool evaluates.
